renders._yaml:
- component: advanced_viz
  id: kmer_spectrum
  title: Read k-mer spectrum
  description: |-
    Each point is a multiplicity: how many distinct k-mers occur that many times in the reads, with one curve per read set on a log vertical axis. It answers what sequencing depth the reads reach and whether the genome is heterozygous or repetitive.
    How to read: the k-mers piled up near a multiplicity of 1 are mostly sequencing errors. The main peak is the depth of the genome, a smaller peak at half of it is the heterozygous share, and peaks at three and four times that half are repeats.
    Note: GenomeScope needs at least 15x coverage of the haploid genome to fit well.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tbenavi1/genomescope2.0/master/README.md and https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32188846/
  kind: profile
  config:
    x_title: K-mer multiplicity (times seen in the reads)
    y_title: Distinct k-mers
    log_y: true
  roles:
    series: read_set
    x: multiplicity
    y: kmers

- component: advanced_viz
  id: kmer_mass_spectrum
  title: K-mer mass spectrum
  description: |-
    Each point is a multiplicity: the total number of k-mers in the reads that occur that many times, with one curve per read set. It answers where most of the sequenced bases sit.
    How to read: the mass is concentrated at the main peak for a clean genome. Mass far to the right comes from repeats, and mass at multiplicity one is sequencing error, which inflates a poor library.
  kind: profile
  config:
    x_title: K-mer multiplicity (times seen in the reads)
    y_title: Total k-mers (distinct k-mers times multiplicity)
  roles:
    series: read_set
    x: multiplicity
    y: kmer_mass

- component: figure
  title: Read k-mer spectrum
  description: |-
    Each line is a read set: the number of distinct k-mers at each multiplicity. It answers how the read sets compare on the same axes.
    How to read: curves with peaks at the same multiplicity were sequenced to similar depth. A shifted peak means a different depth or a different genome.
  visu_type: line
  dict_kwargs:
    x: multiplicity
    y: kmers
    color: read_set
    labels:
      multiplicity: K-mer multiplicity
      kmers: Distinct k-mers
      read_set: Read set

- component: card
  title: Main peak depth
  description: |-
    The hero number is the median multiplicity of the main peak over read sets, and the box shows its quartiles. It answers the typical k-mer depth of the sequencing.
    How to read: this is the depth of the genome in k-mers, so a very shallow peak predicts a poor GenomeScope fit. GenomeScope recommends at least 15x coverage of the haploid genome.
    Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tbenavi1/genomescope2.0/master/README.md
  column: peak_multiplicity
  aggregation: median
  aggregations:
  - box_plot_stats
  secondary_layout: box_plot
  caption: peak multiplicity per read set, with its spread

- component: table
  title: K-mer histogram
  description: |-
    Each row is a multiplicity of a read set with its number of distinct k-mers, the k-mer mass and the peak multiplicity. It answers the raw numbers behind the spectrum.
    How to read: the histogram is cut past the main peak and thinned, so it is for reading the shape, not for exact counts.
